name: Flags of Europe
author: Addicting Games
description: Flags of Europe is a map game that teaches you about European geography. Are you a pro at identifying flags? Do you know the flags of Greece, Italy, or France? Can you tell apart the flags of Austria, Croatia, and Ukraine? Even if you are not a flag geek, this is a great game to help teach you the flags of Europe. Whether you have a big test or you just want to impress your friends, Flags of Europe is a great educational game to train your mind. Not only must you identify the flag, but you must click on the correct location on the map. Bad at this map game? Don’t worry, the game teaches you as you play so that you get better every time. Learn about European geography and the flags with this fun educational game.
